name: DocumentFragment
title: DocumentFragment — nodeType 11
description: Fragment node; ShadowRoot is a specialized DocumentFragment, not a separate nodeType.

placement.parent: None. A DocumentFragment is always a root; it is never a child of another node.

serialization.text_html: Not serialized itself; its children are serialized in order. Inserting a fragment moves its children into the target and leaves the fragment empty.

creation: document.createDocumentFragment(), a template element’s .content, or element.attachShadow() for a ShadowRoot

notes.note: ShadowRoot and template contents are DocumentFragments.
